voice.summary: Framelix sounds like a producer pitching a trailer: confident, visual and a little hurried. Deadlines and deliverables are stated in hours, never vaguely.
dos: State turnaround in hours or days
Name the deliverable: reel, logo sting, product loop
Use film vocabulary sparingly: cut, frame, reel
donts: Never leave out the turnaround time

taglines: Motion with a point of view
boilerplate: Framelix 3D is a cinematic motion studio delivering product animations, logo stings and reels in 24 to 48 hours, with a catalogue of ready-made scenes.
